findings.evidenceJa: 背中の傷は擦り傷だろう
findings.governingReading: 擦り傷 specifies scraped skin, later visibly scratched all over and treated topically.
The authored English explains Sakura’s inability to sleep.
findings.explanation: Fall sleep omits the required a in asleep.

findings.highlight: I...just needed to use the bathroom and happened to pass by the entrance.
findings.evidenceJa: たまたま玄関にいただけですよ？
findings.governingReading: The Japanese closes her speech after the entrance excuse, before narrator silence and inference.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s two-row bathroom explanation has an opening quote but no closing quote.

findings.highlight: Sakura steps in front of me.
findings.governingReading: そんな俺を前にして describes her reaction facing him before returning the home greeting.
findings.explanation: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.

findings.highlight: just dress the wounds with gauze.
findings.evidenceJa: 傷口を拭いてガーゼでも貼っといてくれ
findings.governingReading: 傷口を拭いて precedes the requested dressing after he asks for no more antiseptic.
findings.explanation: Wiping the wound before gauze is omitted.

findings.highlight: she pouted until I confessed that I got injured
findings.evidenceJa: 拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果
findings.governingReading: 拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果 makes questioning the means by which he is made to confess the injury.
findings.explanation: Persistent questioning with a pout becomes simply pouting until confession.

findings.highlight: Something urgent came up, so she had to leave.
findings.evidenceJa: 急な話だけど、あいつは帰った
findings.governingReading: 急な話だけど comments on the sudden news before saying she went home and will not return.
findings.explanation: An abrupt departure story becomes an urgent event forcing her to leave.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺は何をもって応えるべきなのか
findings.governingReading: 何をもって応えるべきなのか asks what he should offer in response to the six days she was his sword.
findings.explanation: How he ought to respond now becomes how he repaid her before.

findings.highlight: I'm probably going to be out of the house from tomorrow
findings.evidenceJa: 明日からもっと家を留守にするだろう
findings.governingReading: もっと家を留守にする forecasts greater absence while explicitly allowing Sakura to keep using the house.
findings.explanation: More absence from tomorrow loses the increase.

findings.highlight: I'm going to be a man who does what's right.
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になるって言ったんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou invokes his earlier declaration that he would become a hero of justice.
findings.explanation: English restates Shirou's resolve but omits his reminder that he had already declared this commitment.
